Name: Edward
Description: 'Edward' was trained by a specialist by the name of 'Van Cleef', not much is known about his childhood or his earlier years. He wasn't always the cold blooded murderer that Anita knows, Anita maybe one of the few people alive who has glimpsed at the real 'Edward' and found something beneath the mask. He is a consummate actor, he can dress and act well enough to blend into any situation or area. The only thing that gives him away are his eyes.
